name: Burg Starhemberg
kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Starkenberg near Tarrenz towers as a historic castle complex over the Gurgl Valley, combining medieval knightly lore with centuries-old brewing tradition.
beschreibung:
Overview

The storied Schloss Starkenberg (also known as Burg Starkenberg), perched above the village of Tarrenz near Imst, is one of the most intriguing fortresses in the Tyrolean Oberland. Founded in the 12th century by the powerful Lords of Starkenberg to safeguard the crucial transalpine trade route from the Fern Pass into the Inn Valley, the fortress endured turbulent sieges before evolving into an imposing castle residence. Behind its fortified curtain walls and stout keep lies a one-of-a-kind cultural and gastronomic destination: the historic Starkenberg Castle Brewery, which has crafted award-winning artisanal beers on site for over two centuries. Visitors can discover an atmospheric blend of medieval fortification architecture, museum galleries, and the world's first beer swimming pool nestled inside the castle cellars.

Route & Requirements

Exploring the castle grounds is an enjoyable and easy cultural excursion for families, hikers, and history enthusiasts of all generations. From Tarrenz village, a scenic, gently climbing footpath leads through green meadows and mixed forest to the castle gate in about twenty minutes. Walking paths are well maintained; comfortable leisure footwear is recommended for navigating historic flagstones, courtyards, and vaulted cellar chambers. A complete tour of the castle exhibitions and brewing exhibits takes approximately one to two hours and requires no athletic stamina. Informative multilingual displays and guided tours vividly illuminate medieval knightly feuds and traditional alpine brewing craft.

Visiting & Getting There

Tarrenz is situated in the Gurgl Valley just north of Imst, with excellent transport accessibility. Regional buses run regularly from Imst-Pitztal railway station directly to Tarrenz, from where the castle is an easy walk. Drivers will find designated parking spaces right below the castle complex. The castle museum and brewery experience are open regularly from spring through late autumn. Custom guided tours including beer tastings and cellar visits can be booked in advance for travel groups.

Tips

For an extraordinary wellness experience, book a session in the famed Starkenberg Beer Pools, allowing guests to soak in warm beer vats within historic stone vaults. Combine your excursion with a scenic hike along sections of the Starkenberg Trail or explore the nearby Salvesen Gorge. Afterward, relax in the castle brewery tavern to enjoy hearty Tyrolean specialities and freshly tapped craft ales in the castle courtyard.
